regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your appreciated favor of August 20ch which I just finished reading. I hope this finds you well and improving! For you, that means that by the grace of God you persevere in His holy grace and ser- ice -- resigned in all circumstances to His adorable wil1. Of course it is not wrong to pray for improve- ment of health, etc. But perhaps more meritorious to even offer ourselves to suffer something in union with our dear Lord's suffering and death for our holy Redemption -- remembering too that: "whom the Lord loveth He chastiseth. " Keep courage therefore and I hope that before long - God willing - you surprise the doctors and all concerned.
